title: Recruiters Reject This in 6 Seconds (Fix It Now)
description:
Recruiters spend just 6–8 seconds on your resume. If your bullet points don’t show immediate value, you could be losing the interview!

In this video, I break down the A-T-V method (Action  Task  Value) to transform your weak bullet points into powerful, results-driven statements that make your resume pop in seconds!

transcript: Recruiters spend only six to eight seconds on your resume. If your bullet points don't show value, instantly you're losing the interview. Most résumés simply list what we did. Use a method I developed called ATV bullet points. Action, task, value. Lead with the metric first, then explain what you did. Here's a nonats bullet. Created social media post for a sustainable packaging line and worked with influencers. Here is an ATV bullet point. drove a 60% increase in social media engagement and a 45% sales growth in three months by spearheading targeted campaigns and influencer collaborations. The impact is immediate. Your resume pops in seconds. If you want step-by-step guidance for a resume that pops, check out my linked ré and cover letter online training. And also like and subscribe if you want a practical job search advice from your career best wingwoman.
